questions.stem: Q1. A 75-year-old bedridden patient is admitted to the hospital with pneumonia. During routine care, the nurse notices an area of redness and tissue breakdown over the patient's sacrum. The patient has been immobile for several days due to weakness. Which of the following statements is incorrect regarding pressure sores?
questions.stemHtml: Q1. A 75-year-old bedridden patient is admitted to the hospital with pneumonia. During routine care, the nurse notices an area of redness and tissue breakdown over the patient's sacrum. The patient has been immobile for several days due to weakness. Which of the following statements is incorrect regarding pressure sores?

options.label: A
options.text: Pressure sores occur when external pressure exceeds capillary occlusive pressure of 30 mm Hg

options.label: B
options.text: Malnutrition and neurological deficits are contributing factors to pressure sore development

options.label: C
options.text: The most common site for pressure sores is the greater trochanter

options.label: D
options.text: In case of pressure sores on Malleolus, lateral is more commonly affected than medial
